subject: SORT statement
notes: Rule: 'If an input procedure is specified, control is passed to the input procedure before the file referenced by file-name-1 is sequenced by the SORT statement. The compiler inserts a return mechanism after the last statement in the input procedure. When control passes to that return mechanism, the records that have been released ... are sorted.' (cite.py --check 14.9.40.4 OK, GR11). EmitSort emits SortEnterProcedure + Statements.EmitProcedureRange(ip) (a bounded __Dispatch(start,end) whose bounded return IS the inserted return mechanism) BEFORE SortSort; the range is resolved by the one PERFORM-style procedure resolver incl. THRU and inverted ranges. pb440 pins an inverted IN-B THRU IN-A range (RELEASE C,A,B -> OUT=A/B/C) and an empty section (CNT=0), expected values derived in the golden header. [editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023]
